Odette Spessiva[7] is a playable Cryo character in Genshin Impact.

As the Prima Ballerina of the Korolevskiy Troupe, she dances with a frosty demeanor and unwavering precision. Beyond the stage, she works as a member of the Fatui, and is known to be the favored candidate to inherit the Harbinger seat of her mentor, Signora.[8]

With slow, graceful dance steps, Odette deals AoE Cryo DMG to the opponent, and also summons her Solo Dance DoubleSolo Dance DoubleA psychic double of Odette's that dances a duet with her. May be summoned to the field through her Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst.
Alternates between the Plume and Wing dance moves to periodically attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
A maximum of one Solo Dance Double summoned by Odette is allowed on the field at any one time.

Additionally, when there is a Dance Double summoned by Odette nearby, her Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers is changed to the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling. to the field.
If a Dance Double summoned by Odette is already on the field, this will re-summon the Dance Double and reset its duration.

Solo Dance Double
Alternates between the Plume and Wing dance moves, periodically attacking nearby opponents and dealing to them AoE Cryo DMG.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers, Odette's Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers will become the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's TollingAdagio: Coda at Dawn's TollingOdette's special Elemental Skill, which deals to nearby opponents AoE Cryo DMG over time. Then, when the dance duel ends, she deals another instance of AoE Cryo DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG. During the dance duet, Odette can control the direction of the dance steps.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The DMG dealt when the dance duet ends is changed to AoE Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar reaction type.

Additionally, after Odette unleashes the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling, should she be in the Radiance: Stellar Glimmer state while her Dance Double is still on the field, the Dance Double's two dance move types will also deal additional AoE Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type. instead, where a dance duet deals AoE Cryo DMG to nearby opponents over time. Then, when the duet ends, she deals another instance of AoE Cryo DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG.

  • When Skill DMG or Coda at Dawn's Tolling DoT hits at least one enemy, it generates 5 Elemental Particles.
    • This particle generation has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
  • Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling deals three instances of AoE Cryo DMG before the Cryo Stellar Glimmer finisher.
  • Solo Dance Double will perform one dance move every 2s.

Pathetique of Pateticheskaya
4th Ascension Passive
  • Description
  • Gameplay Notes

For every 100 ATK Odette has over 1,000, her Stellar Glimmer DMG is additionally increased by 1.5% of the original DMG. She can deal up to 30% more additional DMG in this way.

  • The DMG increase increases the Base DMG Multiplier directly, and is not a Reaction Base DMG Bonus.
    • Consequently, it only applies to Stellar Glimmer DMG dealt directly by Odette, and not any indirect Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG she contributes to.
Dance of Aurore
Stellar Jubilee Passive
Odette will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when she is inside a Polestar FieldPolestar FieldWhen Stellar-Conduct is triggered, the surrounding area will transform into a Polestar Field for a short period of time, and when inside a Polestar Field, certain characters will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state, which grants various skill buffs., or the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Odette's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.
Echo of Winter Daydreams
Utility Passive
  • Description
  • Gameplay Notes
  • Preview

Shows the locations of Snezhnaya's Local Specialties on the mini-map.
Practicing dance in one's spare time might even trigger other effects...

  • Odette must be in the active party for Echo of Winter Daydreams to take effect, but she does not need to be alive.
  • Only one local specialty will be shown on the mini-map at a time.
  • The following Talent is identical to this talent:
    • Treetop Watch (Alyosha)
  • When Odette is in her dancing idle animation, her Elemental Skill is replaced by a button that can be tapped repeatedly to extend her dance.
    • Tapping her Elemental Skill will add additional pirouettes and fouettés to her performance, extending her idle animation to a maximum of ~30s.
    • While in Snezhnaya, during Odette's dancing idle animation, a variation of a section of Odette's Character Trailer theme plays.

Talent Demo[]

TitleDescription
Character SummaryOdette is a Cryo character with both off-field DPS and support capabilities. She can also enable the party to trigger Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl reactions.
After using her Elemental Skill , Odette will summon a double of herself. This double will stay on the field and attack nearby opponents periodically. Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by party members is also increased.
After Odette unleashes her Elemental Burst , she will deal more Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG for some time.
Stellar-Conduct ReactionWhen Odette is in the party, Superconduct reactions triggered by party members will be converted to Stellar-Conduct reactions. A Starlight Prism will appear on the field, turning the surrounding area into a wondrous Polestar Field for a short period of time.
All characters inside the Polestar Field receive a Cryo and Electro DMG Bonus, and when opponents within the field are hit by Cryo or Electro attacks, the field will store the dissipating elemental energies and then completely release them every 4s. This further increases the aforementioned DMG Bonus and also increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG coefficient for 4s.
Additionally, opponents within the Polestar Field will also have their Physical RES lowered.
